# New TunePad cell

# Lower the cello volume to balance it with the other track
cello_volume = 70

# Measures 1-4
# MIDI notes for Measure 1
measure1_notes = [48, 48, 48, 45]
# duration of each note in Measure 1
measure1_beats = [1.5, 0.5, 1, 1]
# MIDI notes for Measure 2
measure2_notes = [52, 50, 48, 43]
# duration of each note in Measure 2
measure2_beats = [1, 1, 1, 1]
# repeat Measures 1-2 twice to create Measures 1-4
for x in range(2):
    # go through each note in Measure 1
    for i in range(len(measure1_notes)):   
        playNote(
            # play the note at position i
            measure1_notes[i],   
             # play it for 85% of its original beat
            measure1_beats[i] * 0.85,
            velocity = cello_volume
        )
        # add a short rest for the remaining 15%
        rest(measure1_beats[i] * 0.15)       
    # go through each note in Measure 2
    for i in range(len(measure2_notes)):   
        playNote(
            # play the note at position i
            measure2_notes[i],
             # shorten the note slightly
            measure2_beats[i] * 0.85,
            velocity = cello_volume
        )
         # add a small gap to make it sound less mechanical
        rest(measure2_beats[i] * 0.15)     

        
# Measures 5-9
notes = [
    # Measure 5 notes
    48, 52, 48, 45,
    # Measure 6 notes
    48, 50, 52,
    # Measure 7 notes
    48, 45, 48, 52, 48,
    # Measure 8 notes
    45, 45, 48,
    # Measure 9 notes
    48, 48, 45, 48
]

beats = [
    # Measure 5 beat lengths
    1, 1, 1, 1,
    # Measure 6 beat lengths
    1, 1, 2,
    # Measure 7 beat lengths
    1, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 1,
    # Measure 8 beat lengths
    1, 1, 2,
    # Measure 9 beat lengths
    1, 1, 1.5, 0.5
]

# go through every note in the list
for i in range(len(notes)):
    # play each note for 85% of its original beat
    playNote(notes[i], beats[i] * 0.85, velocity = cello_volume)
    # use the remaining 15% as a small gap
    # this makes the cello sound less mechanical
    rest(beats[i] * 0.15)
    
    
# Measures 10-14
notes = [
    # Measure 10 notes
    52, 48, 52,
    # Measure 11 notes
    43, 43, 43,
    # Measure 12 note
    43,
    # Measure 13 notes
    43, 43, 43,
    # Measure 14 note
    43
]
beats = [
    # Measure 10 beat lengths
    1, 1, 2,
    # Measure 11 beat lengths
    1, 1, 2,
    # Measure 12 beat length
    2,
    # Measure 13 beat lengths
    1, 1, 2,
    # Measure 14 beat length
    2
]


# Measures 10 and 11 have six notes in total
for i in range(6):
    # play each note for 85% of its original duration
    playNote(notes[i], beats[i] * 0.85, velocity = cello_volume)
    # use the remaining 15% as a small gap
    # this makes the cello sound less mechanical
    rest(beats[i] * 0.15)


# Measure 12
# play the note for 85% of its original duration
playNote(notes[6], beats[6] * 0.85, velocity = cello_volume)
# add a small gap after the note
rest(beats[6] * 0.15)
# the second half of Measure 12 is silent
rest(2)


# Measure 13
# positions 7, 8 and 9 are the three notes in Measure 13
for i in range(7, 10):
    # shorten each note slightly
    playNote(notes[i], beats[i] * 0.85, velocity = cello_volume)
    # add a small gap after each note
    rest(beats[i] * 0.15)


# Measure 14
# play the final note for 85% of its original duration
playNote(notes[10], beats[10] * 0.85, velocity = cello_volume)
# add a small gap after the final note
rest(beats[10] * 0.15)
# finish the piece with a two-beat rest
rest(2)
